node.title: Re: Problem with perlcritic when using Moose object
node.author: haj
node.doctext:
Edited (again): As haukex points out in [id://1223581|his reply], I've apparently just been paranoiac without a good reason. There's nothing wrong with an unquoted shift within braces, the following advice can safely be scratched.

Instead of if($hash->{shift}) { $Person->shift( $hash->{shift} ); } use: if($hash->{'shift'}) { $Person->shift( $hash->{'shift'} ); } The Perl parser could confuse the bareword shift in the braces with its core function [doc://shift] instead of converting it to a string. (edited because I tested the stuff and found out that it does not confuse it right now).
